brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net create me a website that lets me search bluesky but only the posts of simcluster people or simcluster adjecent people or make it a cool selector that chooses any area from bluesky-map.theo.io

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [link: https://bluesky-map.theo.io — Bluesky Map — Interactive map of 3 million Bluesky users, visualised by their follower pattern.]
note: built simcluster-search: live-crawls a handle's mutuals + one-way follows, then searches only within that group -- plus a link to bluesky-map.theo.io for other corners of the network.
